name: Power Platform Environment
description: Power Platform environment named per ALM environment strategy: <lifecycle>-<region>-<business unit>-<purpose>. Maintain at minimum Dev/Test/Prod. When creating an environment, choose its type explicitly (Sandbox vs Production) — the lifecycle token should match that type. Rename the default environment ('{tenant} (default)') to a descriptive name.

fields.name: Lifecycle
fields.tip: Match the lifecycle token to the environment TYPE chosen in the Power Platform admin center: Sandbox types (Dev/Test/Sandbox) vs Production.
